description:
Racing Thoughts | Veena Instrumental | 1.5 Hours of calm Indian music to slow a spinning mind

It is late, the day is over, and your mind is still running laps — replaying conversations, rehearsing tomorrow, refusing to sit down.

This peaceful Indian ambient music gives a racing mind 90 minutes of low, steady ground to land on.

You'll hear the veena — a deep, resonant plucked instrument — moving in long unhurried phrases over a soft tanpura drone. No percussion, no swells, nothing sudden. Just weight and warmth, low enough to think slower against.

Perfect for evening anxiety, overthinking, a mind that won't switch off, decompressing after a heavy day, or quiet company while journaling it all out.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Veena
Raga: Darbari — the deep, grave night raga, built for settling
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Grounded, unhurried, steady
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on when the mental noise starts and keep the volume low — this music works underneath your evening, not on top of it. Headphones deepen the drone.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00:00 — Noticing the noise
0:08:00 — First ground
0:15:00 — Slowing the loop
0:23:00 — Longer breaths
0:30:00 — The mind sits down
0:38:00 — Low and steady
0:45:00 — Fewer thoughts
0:53:00 — Settling deeper
1:00:00 — Quiet weight
1:08:00 — Room to rest
1:15:00 — Still water
1:23:00 — Carrying the calm to bed

⏱ BEST FOR
Evening anxiety
Overthinking and mental loops
A mind that won't switch off
Decompressing after a heavy day
Journaling
Gentle background calm
Pre-sleep wind-down
Breathing exercises

If this music helped, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.
